item.title: Encrypted patches, unlocked on patch day
item.description: Ship a security fix early as ciphertext and publish the key at release time, so teams can stage it and apply it together instead of racing attackers. What games already do, a design with signed keys, open source in private, the air-gapped case and the patents.
